title: Pitfall spatial capture-recapture of 126 spotted skink (Oligosoma lineoocellatum) on two 231-trap grids at Lake Station, New Zealand, October and November 1995
creator: Efford, Murray G.; Thomas, B. W.; Spencer, N. J. (data, unpublished; distributed in the secr R package)
citation: Efford, M. G. (2026). secr: Spatially explicit capture-recapture models (Version 5.5.1) [R package; dataset lineoCH]. CRAN. https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=secr
abstract: Skinks were pitfall-trapped on two grids of 11 x 21 baited cans 5 m apart on a bracken hillside at Lake Station, Upper Buller Valley, South Island, New Zealand, in a study of habitat use and competition between Oligosoma lineoocellatum and Oligosoma infrapunctatum. Sessions 6 (17-20 October 1995) and 7 (14-17 November 1995) of the 1995-1996 study, 3 daily checks each; skinks toe-clipped and released. The data are secr's lineoCH, with snout-vent length and trap-site habitat. One row per skink x trap x day.
samplingProtocol: Two grids of 11 x 21 pitfall traps (sunken cans baited with fruit in syrup) at 5 m, cleared daily for 3 days per session; skinks marked by toe clipping; captures with uncertain identity, and same-day recaptures at a different trap, dropped by the source.
surveyEvidenceNote: Trap usage is not deposited; every pitfall is taken as open on all 3 days of both sessions, as secr assumes (the help page says some sessions of the wider study were incomplete, not these two). Each skink has rows at all 462 traps x 3 days x 2 sessions.
closureNote: period (closed within a 3-day session, open between the two)
geographicCoverage: Lake Station, Upper Buller Valley, South Island, New Zealand; the trap array centroid is at about 41.8 S, 172.7 E (0.1 degree); trap coordinates in __traps are centred on it
crs: local metres centred on the array centroid (NZ Map Grid positions withheld)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: trap coordinates centred on the array centroid by the processor (metres; exact NZ Map Grid positions withheld) because Oligosoma lineoocellatum is IUCN EN (GBIF's IUCN category) and Oligosoma infrapunctatum shares the array; the centroid is given at 0.1 degree in geographicCoverage

designNote: Experimental list of E9: two-session spatial capture-recapture with a trap key and __traps; the two grids are trap_grid in __traps. One table per species (ruling #20); the sibling table holds the other species on the same traps.
notes: unit_svl_first_mm = snout-vent length at the first session caught. Trap-site habitat in __traps (1-m radius plots; definitions on the help page; trap_habitat_class from fuzzy clustering). The third species, O. polychroma, was seldom caught and is not in the data. Unit ids are the source's. Sibling: efford_1995_buller_infraskink_scr.

notShipped.trap_totals: per-trap total captures of each species Apr 1995-Mar 1996 (INFRA, LINEO, POLY): summaries over sessions not in the data
